name: Shidou Haruka
source: [url=/c34759]Risa's[/url] younger sister and another one of Hiroki's childhood friends whom he reunited with a while ago. Unlike her sister, Haruka is happy to see her childhood friends again. Haruka is also very mother-like, being kind and friendly to anybody. Due to this, she often tries to get Risa and Hiroki to get along. She also has a secret crush on [url=/c34765]Yuuma[/url].
